frequency_question: How often does headline CPI print above 5.0 percent in months experiencing concurrent food price shocks and active central bank tightening?
membership_rule: Large emerging market economies operating under flexible inflation targeting with food weight above 45% in the CPI basket, during quarters affected by agricultural output shocks.
provenance_note: 4 cases named, 10 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.5x)
coverage_note: 4 named episodes; believed roughly 10 comparable systemic food-shock quarters in the post-inflation-targeting era.
known_gaps: Excludes minor localized droughts that did not scale to national headline prints.
skeleton: Recurring monsoon-driven vegetable and cereal price shock cycles across four distinct multi-year weather anomaly periods.
multiplier: 4 episodes identified where inflation breached 5.0% due to analogous food supply side pressures out of 10 total observed shock windows.
validity_reason: Structural food weight in the consumer basket and vulnerability to monsoon volatility remain stable over this medium-term horizon.
